svg.title: Overview of micromagnetic boundary conditions across magnetic, periodic, airbox, and mechanical domains
svg.desc: Four-panel overview of Fullmag boundary conditions: (a) free-surface Neumann A d_n m = 0 via FEM weak natural integral vs FDM ghost clamping; (b) chiral DMI boundary condition 2A d_nu m + D[(n_hat x nu) x m] = 0 with numerically computed edge canting profile; (c) periodic boundary conditions in FDM (wrapped neighbor indices) vs FEM (reduced P^T A P); (d) FEM airbox closures (Dirichlet u = 0 vs asymptotic Robin d_n u + beta u = 0) and mechanical BCs.
svg.text: Boundary Conditions Across Magnetic, Periodic, Airbox, and Mechanical Domains
Physical boundary laws, weak natural vs. strong essential enforcement, and FDM vs. FEM discrete realizations
Zero exchange flux at free surfaces: natural FEM weak form vs. FDM ghost clamping
A (∇m) n̂ = 0 → zero normal slope at edge
Inactive/open neighbor j ∉ A uses mj ← mi
Boundary twist over length ℓDMI = 2A/|D|; natural weak residual in FEM
Periodic BCs: FDM Wrapped vs. FEM Reduced PT A P
Translational seam m(r + Ld êd) = m(r) declared via study.pbc(...)
FEM: Reduced DOF Space PT A P
Outer marker Γa (Dirichlet u=0 vs. Robin ∂nu + βu = 0) and ElasticBody constraints
Essential DOF elimination; requires large Ωa
2. Robin Closure: ∂nu + β u = 0 on Γa
β = c / R★; adds boundary mass β BΓa
Higher accuracy at compact airbox scales.
• Traction-free: σ · n = 0 • Clamped (fixed): u = 0 • Prescribed load: σ · n = t
